architecture: Horizontal built-in motor spindle; X and Z on linear guides with direct-drive ball screws; 12-station servo Duplomatic turret with horizontal axis, hydraulic clamp; servo tailstock. M (live tools, C), Y (upper X' + Y) and S (counter spindle on W) versions.

spindle.curve_points: S2-30min: constant 160.2 Nm to 850 rpm then 14.3 kW to 6000; S1: 124.6 Nm to 1025 rpm then 13.4 kW (A2-5 6,000 rpm headstock power graph)

tailstock: servo-driven automatic, MT-4, max axial force 300 kgf
options: A2-6 headstock 4,500 rpm, 73 mm bore, 210 mm chuck, 51/64 mm bar
M version: VDI30 live, X 195 mm, max cut dia 250
Y version: BMT-45, Y +/-50 mm, Y rapid 18 m/min
S version: counter spindle A2-5 6,000 rpm 14.3 kW, W rapid 18
notes: Std = T version (fixed tools), A2-5 headstock: spindle hole 61 mm, chuck 165 mm (6.5 in, also 175/210), bar 42 mm (51 opt). Max cutting dia T = 282 mm; swing over Z-axis cover 530, over X table 420. X travel T/Y/S = 160 mm, M = 195. Live tools (M/Y): 0-6,000 rpm, min motor torque 18 Nm continuous. Main motor 19.4 hp / 14.3 kW intermittent. Height 2,009 (T/M), area 2,927 x 2,019 front x side. Weight 4,800 kg without conveyor.
